name: KeyValueList
purpose: Stack Key Value Pair items vertically in a semantic <dl> element.
intent: A thin layout wrapper that provides the <dl> (description list) structure screen readers need to announce key/value pairs correctly. Resets browser default margins and uses a flex column layout. Individual pairs manage their own padding and dividers.

figmaSource.note: 2 variants (underlined vs. clean). The underline treatment is delegated to each child KeyValuePair's own underline prop.
apiAdaptationNotes: Figma models the underlined/clean distinction as list-level variants. In code, underline is a per-pair prop on KeyValuePair, giving finer control (e.g. omitting the underline on the last item).
The list renders a <dl> for semantic HTML. Figma uses an auto-layout frame.

useCases: a record's details, one Key Value Pair per row: a summary card, a side panel, a settings overview
a mix of read-only details and details people can edit in place

className.description: Composes with the <dl> element's class list.

anatomy.description: Flex column container. Resets browser default dl margin/padding.
The Key Value Pairs, one per row. Each sets its own height, size, and underline divider.

accessibility.role: A <dl> element — screen readers announce the description list structure.
accessibility.structure: Children must be KeyValuePair items (or equivalent <dt>/<dd> structures).

behaviorRules: Render a <dl> holding the children; className composes onto it, and no other attributes are passed through.
Stack the rows in a column with no gap, margin, or padding of its own (the <dl>'s browser defaults are cleared).
The list has no size or divider of its own: each Key Value Pair sets its own height, size, and underline. Figma's underlined/clean list variants are underline on every pair but the last, or on none.

A row grows with its value, and the rows below move down. A pair edited with Inline Edit's actionPlacement="end" keeps its height while editing, so the rows below stay where they are; the default placement (below) moves the rest of the list down.
The <dl> has no accessible name of its own; a heading before it names the group.
The list is not focusable and has no keyboard behavior; the inline controls in its pairs keep their own.
do: Use as the wrapper for multiple Key Value Pair items.
Control underlines per-pair with KeyValuePair's underline prop.
Give a pair edited with InlineEdit actionPlacement="end", so the list doesn't shift while someone edits.
dont: Don't nest non-KeyValuePair content directly — the <dl> expects <dt>/<dd> children.
Don't use for tabular data that needs sorting/filtering.
acceptanceCriteria: Renders multiple Key Value Pair children, with every key and value shown.
Adds no spacing or tokens of its own; rows sit directly against each other.
Storybook includes StaticUnderlined, StaticClean, MixedEditable, and Sizes.
Tests cover the <dl> root, multiple Key Value Pair children, and className.
behaviorNotes: Pure layout container — no interactive states, no spacing of its own.
Each child KeyValuePair manages its own padding and optional underline.
knownLimitations: No built-in divider management — set underline individually on each KeyValuePair.
